title: Philosophy Of Education
modules: Curriculum: The Nature Of Education In Nigeria
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the uses of the subject to us as individuals and as members of a society."
The functions of philosophy are the uses of the subject to us as individuals and as members of a society.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very essential instrument for doing philosophy."
The mind is a very essential instrument for doing philosophy.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the individualized method of teaching which has been difficult to implement in Nigerian situation."
The only exception is the individualized method of teaching which has been difficult to implement in Nigerian situation.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the "reconstruction or reorganisation of experience which adds to the meaning of experience and increases the ability to direct the course of subsequent experience"."
Dewey says that education is the "reconstruction or reorganisation of experience which adds to the meaning of experience and increases the ability to direct the course of subsequent experience".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as an education that enables a person to enjoy his leisure activities better."
Liberal education can be defined as an education that enables a person to enjoy his leisure activities better.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as follows: As that which does not appear to the sense, abstract concept, such as essence, existence, goodness etc. explanation of the nature of being or reality per se."
Metaphysics can be defined as follows: As that which does not appear to the sense, abstract concept, such as essence, existence, goodness etc. explanation of the nature of being or reality per se.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with the rightness or wrongness of an action."
Ethics is concerned with the rightness or wrongness of an action.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as absence of restraint."
Freedom is defined as absence of restraint.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a form of skepticism which denies objective view, universal knowledge or truth, and maintains that truth if entirely relative depending on the point of view from which it is perceived."
Relativism is a form of skepticism which denies objective view, universal knowledge or truth, and maintains that truth if entirely relative depending on the point of view from which it is perceived.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process of socialisation and an instrument of national development when it is best utilised."
According to them education is a process of socialisation and an instrument of national development when it is best utilised.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the science of the law of thought."
Understand also that logic is defined as the science of the law of thought.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the fruitful ordering of subject matter designed to produce knowledge, skills and attitude in our children."
Curriculum design is the fruitful ordering of subject matter designed to produce knowledge, skills and attitude in our children.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process of education which takes place through interaction with elders, age mates, and friends."
Informal education is a process of education which takes place through interaction with elders, age mates, and friends.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the representative of culture, the custodian of knowledge and hence the transmitter of basic truth to the child."
The teacher is the representative of culture, the custodian of knowledge and hence the transmitter of basic truth to the child.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sign of being an educated person."
Being critical is a sign of being an educated person.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the major source of knowledge."
Sense experience is the major source of knowledge.

dialectic or Socrates method
